metadata.title: Urban Country Portrait with Scrawled Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A close-up portrait framed by out-of-focus foreground elements, featuring jittery, hand-scrawled typography against a textured blue urban backdrop.

recipe.visualDefinition: A male subject in a flat cap is viewed through a 'window' created by blurred, out-of-focus limbs or objects in the extreme foreground. The background is a vibrant, textured blue wall with faint graffiti-like markings. The typography is characterized by a nervous, hand-drawn quality with varying stroke weights and irregular baselines.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject framed by out-of-focus foreground elements
High-contrast white and black hand-lettering against blue
Textured urban background contrasting with smooth skin tones
Asymmetrical text placement balancing the central portrait
coreInvariants: Extreme foreground bokeh framing the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered but slightly tilted, occupying the middle ground at a medium-close-up scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the sharp texture of the flat cap.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the blurred foreground frame to the subject's face, then to the large scrawled name, and finally to the smaller vertical text block on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The blue wall provides negative space for the typography to breathe despite the busy foreground.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cerulean blue background with high texture.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm skin tones and brown/grey clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Crisp white and deep black for the hand-drawn text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background with naturalistic, slightly desaturated tones on the subject.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain earthy tones for the subject

letterConstructionRules: Varying stroke thickness as if drawn with a marker
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters like 'R' and 'N' have sharp, aggressive angles
The 'O' is often slightly squashed or irregular
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair large, high-contrast scrawled display text with smaller, vertically stacked versions of the same hand-drawn style.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the raw, tactile feel of the original scrawl.
Captures the verticality and nervous energy.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man in a flat cap, framed by blurred foreground elements, against a textured blue urban wall with faint green graffiti arrows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply hand-scrawled, jittery uppercase lettering in white and black, using a marker-drawn style with irregular baselines.

verificationChecks: Is the text jittery and hand-drawn?
Is the foreground sufficiently blurred to create a frame?
Is the background a textured blue?
Does the text overlap the subject slightly?

adjustableVariables: Degree of jitter in the typography
mustRedesign: Ensure the foreground framing is not sharp

mustAchieve: Tactile, hand-made feel in the text

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text looks like it was drawn by hand.
Verify the blue background has visible wall texture.
Ensure the foreground elements are out of focus.
Confirm the typography is the primary graphic element.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Foreground Bokeh Frame + Textured Blue Wall + Jittery Hand-Scrawled Typography
